annotations.title: Switch a tracked link off, or back on

description: Switches off a tracked link that has already been sent. Anyone who opens it afterwards sees that it is no longer available, and the sender is emailed that somebody tried. This changes what a recipient can see. It is reversible — `revoked: false` switches the link back on, so use this tool to turn a switched-off link on again — and it deletes nothing: the link, its settings and its whole reading history survive. Deleting a link is possible only on the website, because it deletes its reading records for good. To change a link's settings, use update_share on the same link: switching one off to make a replacement leaves the recipient holding a dead address.

revoked.description: True (the default) switches the link off. False switches it back on.

share_id.description: The share id, the share's slug (the part after /r/ in its link), or the link itself. list_shares returns all three.
